title: CardOption
description: A card that may take part of the planned spend (engine-spec §2 CardOption, engine CardOption). Capacity layers (engine-spec §12.3, bank-rules-spec §5, checked together): card = max(0, raw_available_minor - holds_uncounted_minor - reservations_minor); credit account = cards sharing credit_account_id (main and supplementary cards) share the account's available credit, max(0, that value - the holds and reservations of ALL its cards); pool = max(0, pool available - the holds and reservations of all its member cards). The raw value is kept as reported (may be negative / over limit). Not yet supported by engine model 1.1.0 and therefore not accepted here (rejected, never ignored): daily_cap, temp_limit_expiry, future_releases.

credit_account_id.description: Credit account of the card. Cards with the same credit_account_id form one capacity layer; they must report the same raw_available_minor and the same pool_id (adapter rule, not expressible in JSON Schema).

raw_available_minor.description: Available credit of the card's credit account as last reported by the bank; may be negative. One value per credit account.

holds_uncounted_minor.description: Pre-authorisations / holds the reported value does not include yet. Deducted from this card, its credit account and its pool; record each hold on ONE card of the account (never repeated on every card).

reservations_minor.description: Reservations of other adopted plans on this card. Deducted like holds_uncounted_minor (card, credit account, pool); record each reservation on ONE card.

pool_id.description: Shared credit pool of the card (absent = none); all cards of a credit account name the same pool. A pool without an entry in PlanInput.pools makes the run NEEDS_DATA (MISSING_POOL_SNAPSHOT).

min_split_minor.description: Card-specific minimum part when used (absent = the request's min_split_minor).

repay_from_cash_account_id.description: Cash account that pays this card's repayment; must be one of PlanInput.cash_accounts.

fee_rate.description: Proportional fee rate (rounded UP to the minor unit). Fee = rate part + fee_fixed_minor; it is paid in cash with the repayment on repay_on (engine-spec §12.6).

verified_benefit_rate.description: Verified benefit rate (enters the objective; rounded DOWN).

verified_benefit_cap_minor.description: Cap of the verified benefit (absent = none).

potential_benefit_rate.description: Unverified benefit rate: reported only, never in the objective.

posting_delay_min_days.description: Earliest bank posting, in days after the transaction date.

posting_delay_max_days.description: Latest bank posting, in days after the transaction date; must be >= posting_delay_min_days.
